notes:
• Workout debrief: calculated from your own numbers, instant and offline, with next-time targets.
• Fairer score: a heavier weight counts as progress, and a one-rep dip is no longer a drop.
• Live workout: a new set tick, rolling steppers, connected effort chips, a wavy rest timer and a finish count-up.
• Home: your rings first, today's workout right below, and an update card you can close.
• Arabic and accessibility: a new Arabic font, Western digits, large-text layouts and screen reader labels.
